FORM 8-K

EXAMPLE INDUSTRIES INC.

Item 1.05 Material Cybersecurity Incidents.

On April 24, 2026, Example Industries Inc. identified a security incident affecting a single legacy application. The Company contained the activity within hours and engaged external advisors to confirm remediation.

Based on its investigation to date, the Company has determined that the incident has had no material impact on its business, operations, or financial condition, and the Company does not expect the incident to be reasonably likely to result in a material adverse effect.
